chunk.content: FAO describes the flesh of goatfishes (family Mullidae, which includes Upeneus moluccensis) as of good quality, with some species highly esteemed in certain countries.
chunk.source_quote: The flesh of goatfishes is of good quality and that of some species highly esteemed in certain countries.

source.title: MULLIDAE Goatfishes (surmullets) by J.E. Randall, FAO Species Identification Guide for Fishery Purposes: The Living Marine Resources of the Western Central Pacific
